title: Remind the payroll admin to lock the payroll
summary: Every morning, remind the payroll admin about any approved payroll in Payrolla that is not locked yet as payday gets close.
description: A payroll in Payrolla is paid only after it is locked. Every morning, Taskiem looks for approved payrolls due in the next few days that are not locked yet, and reminds the payroll admin to lock them in Payrolla. It never locks or pays anything itself. Needs Payrolla's Read payroll permission.

params.name: payrolla_connection
params.title: Payrolla connection
params.description: The Payrolla company this follows: its key, from Payrolla → Settings → Connected apps.

params.name: days_before
params.title: Days ahead
params.description: How many days before payday to start reminding.

params.name: remind_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the reminder goes out, Lagos time.

params.name: notify_role
params.title: Who else is told
params.description: The role of whoever locks payrolls in Payrolla.

output.runs: =(has(steps.runs.output.runs) ? steps.runs.output.runs : []).filter(r, timestamp(r.pay_date + 'T23:59:59Z') - timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at) <= duration(string({{days_before}} * 24) + 'h')).map(r, 'to ' + r.period_end + ' (payday ' + r.pay_date + ')')

input.title: Lock the payroll
input.message: ='These payrolls are approved but not locked, and payday is close: ' + steps.due.output.runs.join(', ') + '. Lock them in Payrolla so they can be paid.'
